key.name: enabled
key.description: Off by default. Installing the package must never change how the machine authenticates; the user opts in explicitly.

key.name: strictness
key.description: off: recognition only, not recommended. light: spoof cues veto an unlock. heavy: additionally requires positive evidence of a real 3D face, such as a blink or head motion.

key.name: mode
key.description: Which camera streams to use. Infrared is substantially harder to spoof, because screens emit almost no infrared.

key.name: tau
key.description: Cosine similarity a frame must reach to count as a match. There is no correct universal value: measure yours with eval/far_frr.py. The default is a placeholder with no evidence behind it.

key.name: vote-k
key.description: One lucky frame is not evidence. At least this many of the last vote-n usable frames must clear the threshold.

key.name: scan-timeout-ms
key.description: Keep this short. PAM's authentication conversation is sequential, so the password box is usually unusable until the face attempt finishes.

key.name: require-attention
key.summary: Require eyes open and facing the camera
key.description: Stops the laptop being held up to a sleeping user. Needs MediaPipe Face Mesh, which the bundled worker includes.
